scope.discovery: Direct same-store item links found in saved user-provided seed HTML; category links were excluded.
scope.actions: Public HTML GET only. No cart, account, checkout, or page interaction requests.
scope.request_count_note: Counts product GETs and redirect hops; saved seed HTML was copied from the earlier user-provided observation and is not fetched again.

availability_note: All 20 observed item pages report HIDDEN_STOCK, so visibly displayed per-SKU availability is unknown. Their HTML embeds per-SKU inventory quantities; these are labeled embedded JSON values, and derived availability (zero => out_of_stock, positive => in_stock) is kept separate from visible availability. A SKU without a matched quantity or with hidden_sku=true remains unknown. SKU-level price is the concrete taxIncludedPrice for that SKU, normalized to integer JPY only when the source value is integral; raw value is retained.

schema.sku_axes: option_values uses each product page variantSelectors[].key paired positionally with the row selectorValues[]; values are the raw returned Japanese labels.
schema.identifier_join: Inventory mapping first matches merchantDefinedSkuId to variantMappedInventories[].sku; if absent, falls back to variantId and records inventory_match_key.
